objective: Add a Solo-inspired but evidence-grounded Growth Engine: verified Quest outcomes feed frequent per-skill Mastery XP, explicit attribute evidence, automatic skill discovery, and deterministic evidence-gated skill/attribute evolution without turning global Level into fake competence.

roles_before.artifact: Neon/PostgreSQL system_events is the sole mutable owner of derived RPG state.
Quest v2 owns execution outcome, objectives, evidence and canonical XP/Coins reward.
system-level-xp:v2 owns frequent global Level feedback and is explicitly not competence.
system-skill-competency5:v1 + skill.upserted own evidence-backed real skill tier; unknown stays null.
system-attribute-ordinal5:v1 + system-attribute-evidence:v1 + attribute.set own evidence-backed STR/VIT/INT/DISC/CHA tiers.
system-player-feedback:v2 produces reward/level/achievement notifications and the PWA full-screen celebration.
Quest focus, difficulty, reward economy, streak, Challenge, achievements, shop and Rank have independent owners and must not be changed by skill growth.
Ron OS and claim-specific live owners remain authoritative for real capability evidence.
Git history and append-only system_events preserve prior progression/evidence.

role_dispositions.destination: Growth assignment and any evidence-gated evolution are append-only System events; no second mutable database is introduced.
Quest v2 gains one optional, explicit system-growth:v1 mapping to primary/secondary skills and attribute evidence. Quest completion/reward semantics remain unchanged.
Global Level/XP remains exactly system-level-xp:v2; skill Mastery XP is a separate non-spendable derived counter and never changes Quest XP.
Keep competency Tier 1..5 evidence-gated; add a separate frequent Mastery Level/XP projection and conservative deterministic promotion only when the generic evidence floor is fully met.

Keep STR/VIT/INT/DISC/CHA evidence-gated; verified growth mappings contribute explicit evidence records and deterministic promotion may occur only when system-attribute-evidence:v1 fully supports a higher tier.
Reward feedback adds Growth Scan context; skill discovery/evolution and attribute evolution produce idempotent celebratory feedback through the existing notification/push/PWA path.
No change to focus, Quest rewards/Coins, streaks, Challenge admission/recovery, achievements, shop, Boss/Arc/Rank or external actions.
Growth mappings describe what a Quest can evidence; verified completion is required and no mapping can fabricate upstream facts.
Historical events remain immutable; growth v1 is versioned, can be ignored on rollback, and performs no retroactive skill Mastery backfill.

capability_probes.assertion: A verified rewarded Quest with primary skill growth yields full Quest XP as Skill Mastery XP; secondary skills receive bounded half XP; skill Mastery uses its own curve and never alters global XP.
A skill referenced by a valid growth mapping appears in the player skill view without inventing a competence tier; after verified execution it accumulates Mastery XP.
Skill/attribute numeric tiers change only when the corresponding conservative evidence evaluator fully supports a higher tier; no volume-only or Level-based promotion is allowed.
Reward and global level-up feedback names the actual skill Mastery gain and attribute evidence produced by that Quest; true skill/attribute evolution gets its own idempotent celebration.
Global Level changes alone never add STR/VIT/INT/DISC/CHA or skill competency.
A Quest without a valid explicit growth mapping produces no skill Mastery or attribute evidence.
Growth cannot be assigned after a Quest becomes terminal and v1 performs no automatic historical Mastery backfill.
Quest completion still grants exactly the existing system-quest-reward:v1 XP/Coins once, with no growth multiplier.
Streak, Challenge, achievements, shop, focus and Rank projections remain unchanged by Growth Engine v1.
All growth assignments/evolutions are append-only with policy provenance; disabling v1 leaves historical Quest/reward events fully reconstructable.

tests.expected: mapping normalization, Mastery XP/levels, skill discovery, attribute evidence and promotion planning PASS.
quest.growth.assign validation/idempotency/terminal lock and growth-driven skill/attribute writes PASS.
existing reward/level/achievement feedback plus Growth Scan/evolution celebration PASS.
model/PostgreSQL/Docker smoke plus Growth Engine tests PASS.
skill/attribute UI, controller routing and unrelated System mechanics remain green.

verification.base_head_diff: Adds one prospective Quest v2 growth mapping event and PostgreSQL gate; derives per-skill Mastery XP from existing canonical Quest XP; introduces conservative skill evidence preflight; composes existing attribute evidence for upward-only evolution; adds Growth Scan/evolution notifications and PWA Mastery/evidence surfaces. Preserves global Level/reward/Coins, focus, streak, Challenge, achievements, shop, Boss/Arc/Rank, upstream real-world authority and immutable historical events; no retroactive Mastery backfill or terminal Quest retrofit.
verification.candidate_readback: Final candidate head passed cloud model tests, PostgreSQL action-gate + HTTP smoke, Docker smoke and continuity. Latest PWA-relevant head passed system-pwa-ci #444; latest LifeUp/controller/mechanics-relevant head passed lifeup-system-ci #627. Manual base-to-head review confirmed growth is additive, evidence-gated, upward-only for competence, and leaves unrelated progression/reward/focus/pressure owners intact.
